summary: Completed testing of 3 5xx-robustness fixes (EXPORT-1, R6-4, R6-5). All fixes verified: bad input now returns proper 4xx instead of 500. All regression tests passed - normal usage still works correctly.
passed_tests: EXPORT-1 FIX: Quotation PDF with special/markup characters (<, >, &) returns HTTP 200 with valid PDF (not 500)
EXPORT-1 REGRESSION: Normal quotation PDF generation still works (HTTP 200, valid PDF)
R6-4 FIX: Segment preview with malformed criteria returns HTTP 200/400 (not 500)
R6-4 REGRESSION: Normal segment preview returns HTTP 200 with count/sample fields
R6-5 FIX: Destinations with non-numeric lat/lng returns HTTP 400 with clear error message (not 500)
R6-5 FIX: Packages with non-numeric price returns HTTP 400 with clear error message (not 500)
R6-5 REGRESSION: Destinations with valid numeric lat/lng returns HTTP 200/201 and saves correctly
R6-5 REGRESSION: Packages with valid numeric price returns HTTP 200/201 and saves correctly
